column4: Guards cleat#4465: an answer written over a pending row stores the answer's own time in created_at, so a replay's Now() is the one the live run read. One subtest per dialect (eachDialectDB, or registeredBackends through forEachBackend): in this job only one DSN is set, so the other two dialect arms skip while this one RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name on 2026-11-24 with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone: go test ./engine/ -run '^TestAPromiseAwaitReplaysTheClockItAnsweredWith$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly those two arms.
